fieldNotes.truckGate: Single consolidated truck gate on the north-central access drive at ~37.20202,-76.59533 where the public approach road pinches into the secured yard; gate apron and island clearly visible at z20.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small booth/island structure sits in the gate apron at the pinch point (z20, wm07-z20-gate.png) - a staffed guard shack beside the controlled lane.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a physical guard shack is present.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Deep paved approach and yard between the gate and the dock faces gives ample inside-gate holding room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long tree-lined approach drive from the signalized Pocahontas Trail intersection (~37.2070,-76.5980) to the gate holds well more than 3 trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron with room for multiple lanes / a bypass at the pinch point.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Two ~400m cross-dock buildings with continuous dock walls on both long faces plus a third NE building; well into 50+ band. 500 is an overhead estimate, not exact.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Hundreds of parked drop trailers in angled rows fill the NW storage yard and the central yard between buildings.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock import DC: opposing dock faces / separate buildings function as distinct ship vs receive banks; medium confidence from overhead.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 3 buildings - two large parallel cross-docks plus a smaller building to the NE - on one fenced parcel.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town / wooded parcel off Pocahontas Trail near I-64; broader setting is rural-industrial despite nearby development.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale visible in the gate path; left false.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; port volume is drayed by truck from Hampton Roads.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound at the gate apron; overhead resolution limits exact lane count.
